thesis: Eureka invites both players to place permanents onto the battlefield, but deck construction can make the apparently equal exchange overwhelmingly one-sided.

canonicalIdentity.originalPrintedText: Starting with you, each player may put a permanent card from their hand onto the battlefield. Repeat this process until no one puts a card onto the battlefield.

competitiveTimeline.significance: Eureka served as an early ancestor of Show and Tell strategies and remains a celebrated Old School route for turning enormous permanents into a single explosive turn.

playbook.role: Fill the deck with permanents whose size or immediate impact exceeds what opponents are likely to reveal, and cast Eureka when your hand contains a sequence that survives the opponent’s best response.
